scientific_integrity: The persistence and sharpness statements are proved directly from the base e-BH order-statistic cutoff. The sequential validity statement is a conditional-expectation calculation. Literature comparison was statement-based against the recent adaptive-sampling source, base e-BH, carefree e-process multiple testing, and stopped e-BH; an equivalent construction under different terminology could remain unindexed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem guarantees pathwise coordinatewise persistence for base e-BH and maximal active capital only within affine lock-and-bet continuation rules whose factor may be zero. The anytime-valid FDR interpretation additionally requires globally conditionally valid e-process increments under a common filtration. No sample-complexity, power, or optimal allocation claim is made.
title: Sharp threshold locking for nested e-BH with continued sampling
